title: Rigid strips relay a handle
claim: Rigid strips relay a handle. Dumbbells: a grid, a connector and a second grid joined through two 3-edge cuts, the first grid split at a point there; an opened Fano handle at every attachment point (validated pipeline). (1) With rigid strips (rings over 16- to 48-cycles minus two vertices), at every distance from the first grid up to the strip's far end two strip points relay, and so does a point of the second grid: the handle creates in the first grid beyond the strip, always at the same four lines around the first grid's removed vertex, whatever the strip's length; the claim rule agrees with the pipeline at every first-grid line seen from outside (473 cases). (2) With a liquid connector (a 64- or 256-point grid), only points three steps from the first grid relay; thick tubes relay about half their length. (3) Orientation: a grid receives only through a cut where it is split at a point, and a handle leaves its grid only through a cut where the grid lost a line; with the second grid split at a point too, strip handles relay into both grids and grid handles stay. (4) Exact: on two small dumbbells (two 4-point cubes joined by strips from 8- and 12-cycles), at the points relaying from 5 or more steps, exact creation (join method) agrees with the pipeline in every case and creates in the first grid. Reading: seen from the receiving grid, everything beyond its cut is a composite handle attached at the removed point; a rigid strip carries the Fano plane's opened state to the cut, a liquid connector forgets it; a composite attached at a line is screened, as line-attached handles are (HANDLE-LOCALITY-20261103-001B).
failure_conditions: A rigid strip length where the relayed lines change, or a strip point far from the receiving grid that does not relay.
A liquid connector relaying from beyond three steps.
A relay into a grid whose cut vertices are points, or out of a grid split at a point at that cut.
A small dumbbell where exact creation and the pipeline disagree, or where the relay is not exact.
foundation_claim_scope: Dumbbells: grids joined through two 3-edge cuts by rigid strips (rings minus two vertices), thick tubes or grids; the Fano plane as handle; four census far sides; exact creation on small dumbbells.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-11-03.
validation.status: relays computed exhaustively with the validated pipeline and the claim rule; exact on small dumbbells; no human or external review
